title: Learner knowledge on a cohort of 12 invented learners
cost_source: none: local code only, no model call

results.label: Learner A
results.blurb: Practises most days and improves a little each time.

results.label: Learner B
results.blurb: Learns fast in a session, then loses it over a gap.

results.label: Learner C
results.blurb: Answers at once; about 1 try in 4 is a guess.

results.label: Learner D
results.blurb: Struggles for 10 days, then it clicks.

results.label: Learner E
results.blurb: Often right, but usually after asking for help.

results.label: Learner F
results.blurb: Fast and careless: slips on skills already known.

results.label: Learner G
results.blurb: Slow, careful, rarely wrong, sometimes skips rather than risk it.

results.label: Learner H
results.blurb: Quick start, then no growth after day 7.

results.label: Learner I
results.blurb: Practises only on Saturdays and Sundays.

results.label: Learner J
results.blurb: Strong at multiplication, weak at spelling throughout.

results.label: Learner K
results.blurb: A week away in the middle, then steady work again.

results.label: Learner L
results.blurb: Starts from nothing and practises every day.
